title: A Wall That Has Agreed With Itself
subtitle: 拱与建筑 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 拱与建筑（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：拱与建筑（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：arch　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 arch 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1974 my father stood under ① an arch in a city he could not name and said it was the only honest thing in building. The ② arch, meaning the shape and not the stone, holds because every piece wants to fall and none of them can; an arch, he said, is a wall that has agreed with itself. He said a lintel is a wall that has not.

Every ③ arch in that town was the same height, nine feet, and he said that was not a rule but a habit. The ④ arch of her foot, the doctor said in 1976, had fallen, and she was nine years old; an arch, my mother said, is the only part of a building you can have in your body. She said the doctor used the same word for both, which she thought was a kind of mercy.

My grandfather had ⑤ arches in his back and in his gate, and he walked like a man carrying something he would not put down. The ⑥ arch, meaning the stone thing over the door and not the bone, is the oldest idea in building, my father said; an arch, he said, is the only shape that turns weight into a road. My grandfather said it turns a load into a path, which he said was the same thing said better.

They built a ⑦ brick arch in 1979 and it took nine days and one argument, and it is still there. By 1982 the ⑧ arch had cracked, a hairline down the middle, and he said that was what arches do: an arch, he said, tells you where it will fail before it does.

The ⑨ arch I remember is the one at the end of our lane, under which my grandmother stood for nine minutes in the rain. An ⑩ arch, my father said in 1985, is the only thing in a building that is doing two opposite jobs at once and never mentions it; every arch, he said, is holding up and falling down in the same instant.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 拱；拱门（一座具体的拱）
B. n. 拱形；拱结构（抽象意义）
C. （作定语）拱形的（a brick arch 砖拱）
E. n. （复数）拱起的部位；拱形的弧度
F. n. 拱（指门洞上方那块石头／结构）
G. n. 拱（抽象总称；泛指这种结构）
H. 固定搭配：under an arch 在拱门下

items.q: under an arch in a city he could not name
The arch, meaning the shape and not the stone
arches in his back and in his gate
The arch, meaning the stone thing over the door
An arch, my father said in 1985

answers.why: under an arch 意为“在拱门下”，1974 年父亲站在一座他说不出名字的城市里的一道拱门下。
arch 为抽象意义，指“拱形、拱结构”，它之所以站得住，是因为每一块都想掉下来而谁也掉不下去。
arch 意为“拱、拱门”，那座城里每一道拱都是九英尺高，他说那不是规矩而是习惯。
the arch of her foot 意为“足弓”，1976 年医生说她的足弓塌了，那年她九岁。
arches 为复数，意为“拱起的部位”，祖父的背和步态里都有拱起的弧度。
arch 指门洞上方那块石头（结构），与骨头相对，他说那是建筑里最古老的念头。
brick arch 意为“砖拱”，arch 作定语指用砖砌的拱，1979 年他们砌了一座砖拱，花了九天和一场争吵。
arch 意为“拱”，到 1982 年那道拱裂了，中间一道发丝般的缝。
arch 意为“拱”，我记得的是巷子尽头那道拱，祖母曾在拱下冒雨站了九分钟。
arch 为抽象总称，泛指“拱这种结构”，父亲说它是建筑里唯一同时干着两件相反的事却从不提起的东西。
